Adapted from c-testsuite [tests/single-exec/00004.c](https://github.com/c-testsuite/c-testsuite/blob/5c7275656d751de0e68b2d340a95b5681858ed07/tests/single-exec/00004.c). The local-pointer store body is retained, with the original constants replaced by two arguments and a small main wrapper; the mutation changes the local pointer declaration from int *p to int p. The pinned .otags record identifies the original as `git://git.simple-cc.org/scc`, commit `355356a9836e487939cf5e98b5332a63e5264e27`, path `tests/scc/execute/0004-pointer.c`. That upstream source was retrieved from the public Git repository and verified byte-for-byte against the pinned c-testsuite file. Its applicable ISC license, including the complete copyright and permission notices from that exact SCC commit, is preserved in [LICENSE.scc](../LICENSE.scc); the c-testsuite top-level MIT license does not apply to individual test cases.
